section_summary.extract_value: This section describes an exploratory principal axis factor analysis of the Dutch BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2) using quartimax rotation. The analysis revealed a one-dimensional factor structure with one component explaining 53.24% of variance, with all items showing acceptable factor loadings above .61 except Item 5 (.33), which was retained due to statistical significance and consistency with body image content. The KMO measure (.93) and Bartlett's test confirmed the data were suitable for factor analysis.
